scalar_trace_definition.representation_meaning: sum_(i=0)^m alpha^(m-i) beta^i for alpha+beta=t, alpha*beta=q
scalar_trace_definition.firewall: one scalar trace, not the full degree-(m+1) Sym^m local factor

integer_collision_theorem.scope: every odd integer q and all x,y in Z; elliptic applications take q a positive odd prime power
integer_collision_theorem.odd_classes: if m=1 or 3 mod 6, tau_m(x;q)=tau_m(y;q) iff x=y
integer_collision_theorem.even_class: if m=2 mod 6, tau_m(x;q)=tau_m(y;q) iff x=+y or x=-y

mod_2_quotient_recurrence_certificate.table_index: r mod 12, with m=2r+1 in the odd column and positive m=2r in the even column
mod_2_quotient_recurrence_certificate.warning: this is not a claim that the even quotient table has period 12 in m; its period is 12 in r

recurrences.diagonal_values: formal derivatives at z=0,1; finite recurrence states return after 12 steps

mod_2_quotient_recurrence_certificate.target_conclusion: every zero in a target row has parity (x,y)=(0,0)

odd.margin: v2(product of remaining interval terms)+popcount(2s+1)-1 >= 1 for s>=1
odd.reason: the odd integer 2s+1>=3 has popcount at least 2

even.power_of_two_case: if 2s+2 is a power of two, the interval has at least two even terms, so one remains after removing r,r+1

two_adic_valuation_certificate.conclusion: after the parity step, the constant term is the unique least-2-adic-valuation term, so neither quotient can vanish

sharp_complement.equality: tau_m(0;q)=tau_m(t;q) for every positive m=0,4,5 mod 6
sharp_complement.realization_firewall: the construction supplies Hasse-admissible integer traces; only q=3 is source-witnessed here

full_factor_diagnostics.scope: diagnostics only; the theorem above classifies scalar tau_m fibers, not full-factor fibers

general_zero_vs_nonzero_resolution.conclusion: these differ for every positive m=0,4,5 mod 6, so the constructed t=0 versus t collision is not a full-factor collision

sign_nuance.even_m: t and -t always give the same full Sym^m factor
sign_nuance.odd_m_5_mod_6_at_t_squared_3q: the normalized spectrum is a union of complete six-cycles and is invariant under negation, so the t and -t full factors coincide

m_5_collision_curve_target.geometric_status: the nonzero discriminant gives a nonsingular genus-one smooth projective model over characteristic zero
m_5_collision_curve_target.scope: recorded as a future Diophantine target, not solved or claimed novel here

normalization.family: H_3(q)={monic squarefree cubic D over F_q}
normalization.curve: E_D:y^2=D(x), with the rational point at infinity

source_lock.consumed_measure: uniform monic squarefree cubic models, equivalently normalized elliptic-moduli-stack measure; not uniform coarse isomorphism classes
